note: Multi-season schemes that advance on their own (rules v2). All invention.

agendas.name: The people's assembly
agendas.completes: The assembly takes the generalship from you.

agendas.name: The cavalry come home
agendas.completes: The exiles return. The rich families gain 3 power.

agendas.name: Citizens of Syracuse
agendas.completes: They become citizens. If you refused, they become kingmakers instead.

agendas.name: Choose the next ruler
agendas.completes: The guard backs whichever plot pays best, and does not defend you.

agendas.name: Name the heir
agendas.completes: The family names your successor, and one of your brothers becomes dangerous.

agendas.name: Keeper of the treasury
agendas.completes: He holds the treasury, or a grudge if you refused him.

agendas.name: Your fall
agendas.completes: Their plot gains +2 strength for good.

agendas.name: Take his place
steps: Win the swords or the vote
agendas.completes: You lose your place: the assembly recalls you, the guard or the strongest faction switches to them, they hold too many offices to remove, or a vote exiles you.
